T20 World Cup Final Brings Rivalry to Women's Cricket

The Women's T20 World Cup is set to conclude with a highly anticipated final between England and Australia. The tournament has been marked by intense rivalries, with the two teams having a long history of competition in women's cricket. The final will be played at a neutral venue, bringing together the best sides from each country.
